decision.next_authorized_work: Audit only a scope-adaptive reserved-escape codec: remove the one-bit exception bitmap by reserving one fixed-width table code for a following literal high byte, and choose table width separately for c_fc and c_proj.
decision.reason: The best block-local K=16 candidate uses 14.9183 bits/coordinate, above the 14-bit gate. Its explicit bitmap alone costs one bit/coordinate; its uniform 4-bit index overpays c_fc while c_proj still has a 39.00% escape rate.

interpretation.entropy_is_not_refuted: The prior bit-plane code remains at 13.0365 exact bits, so this failure is the overhead of this parallel format, not an information lower bound.
interpretation.bitmap_is_decisive: Removing the explicit exception bitmap would save exactly 7,077,888 bytes, taking the best measured layout close to 13.918 bits before accounting for a reserved escape symbol.
interpretation.scope_asymmetry_is_decisive: c_fc has only 7.98% escapes at K=16 while c_proj has 39.00%; a uniform index width is structurally inefficient.
interpretation.next_constraint: Reserve one fixed-width code for literals and choose K independently for c_fc and c_proj. This preserves parallel table decode and exact FP16 words without a separate bitmap.
